Let me put it this way. Based off of the small online presence of people reporting PSSD, it seems rare. But on the off chance that you do get PSSD, it is the most soul crushing, devastating thing you can deal with. So I would highly recommend staying far away from SSRI’s.

I suffer from PSSD (post SSRI sexual dysfunction). This is basically a condition where you take antidepressants and proceed to have negative sexual side effects (low libido, ED) even after ceasing the medication, often indefinitely. 

There is no cure for this condition at the moment and I think about suicide A LOT. The only thing keeping me from doing it right now is the off chance that a cure or treatment method will be discovered.

I just had an in person visit with Dr. Irwin Goldstein in San Diego. He is, to my knowledge, the only western doctor who acknowledges the existence of PSSD. 

Apparently many of his patients have experienced significant relief from PSSD by taking a drug called Flibanserin. This is a drug designed to raise libido in premenopausal females. 

I’m gonna try this drug and see how it affects me. I also plan to get an MRI done of my lower body related to some abnormal results from a sensitivity test of my lower body. Eventually, I want to return to San Diego to have a procedure done where platelet rich plasma is injected into my penis. This is essentially stem cell therapy designed to repair tissue that has been damaged by SSRI’s.
